raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Abedi from Arabic 'abid (عابد) = worshipper, devotee; suffix -i = relational/adjectival",
    "reading": "One who is devoted, a servant in the religious sense",
    "languages": ["ar"],
    "source": "Wehr, Hans. A Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "A + be + di; 'be' = to exist, 'di' (Latin) = day; thus 'to be in day'",
    "reading": "Existence in daylight; awakening into consciousness",
    "languages": ["en","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Abedi ~ 'abed' (Hebrew עָבֵד) = servant/slave; also 'abadi' (Persian) = eternal",
    "reading": "Eternal servant; one who serves across time",
    "languages": ["he","fa"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Abedi → 'beida' (Arabic بيضة) = egg; also 'ba' + 'edi' (Old English edi = again)",
    "reading": "The egg that returns; cyclical rebirth",
    "languages": ["ar","en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "A-B-D = Aleph-Bet-Dalet (Hebrew) = father, house, door; i = vowel of connection",
    "reading": "From the father's house to the door; a threshold passage",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "A (alpha) = beginning; B (beta) = second; D (delta) = fourth; E = fifth; I = ninth; sum of positions 1+2+4+5+9=21",
    "reading": "Beginning, duality, door, life, self; total 21 = the world (Tarot)",
    "languages": ["en","grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Abedi in Hebrew gematria: Aleph=1, Bet=2, Dalet=4, Yod=10 → 1+2+4+10=17",
    "reading": "Seventeen, the number of victory and divine order",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "A + bed + i; 'bed' (Old English) = resting place; 'i' = ego; thus 'self in rest'",
    "reading": "The self that finds peace in stillness",
    "languages": ["en","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Abedi ~ 'abed' (French 'à bed' = to bed) + 'i' (Latin) = go; 'go to bed'",
    "reading": "A call to descent into sleep or the underworld",
    "languages": ["fr","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Abedi from Sanskrit 'abhedi' = indivisible, from 'bhid' = to break; a- = not",
    "reading": "That which cannot be broken; unity",
    "languages": ["sa"],
    "source": "Monier-Williams Sanskrit-English Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "A=1, B=2, E=5, D=4, I=9; sequence 1-2-5-4-9; 1+2=3, 5+4=9, 9=9; triple 3-9-9",
    "reading": "Trinity of completion; the ninefold mystery",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Abedi → 'Ibeda' (Old English 'bede' = prayer) + 'a' = a prayer",
    "reading": "A prayer offered in the name of the servant",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  }
]
